# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old as of Volume 1; twenty-three as of Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c13 P0](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0000), [v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Barney is a large, overweight young man with a round face completely devoid of expression. He has a habit of smirking and laughing softly without being able to devise quick answers.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028)_

## Personality

Barney is an extremely shy, quiet, and emotionless youth who suffers from an agonizing inability to hold a conversation. Though slow-witted and awkward in social settings, he is hard-working, dependable, lacks negative vices, and possesses a strong sense of pride.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028), [v1 c23 P20](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0020), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020)_

- Shy and bashful  <sub>[v1 c19 P28](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0028), [v1 c23 P20](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0020)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry and establish his own household on his father's upper farm  <sub>[v1 c23 P20](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0020), [v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000)</sub>

## History

Barney Pullen grows up in Brierley as part of the prominent Pullen family. During a Sunday-school picnic, his father rowed attendees on the Lake of Glassy Waters, and Barney later helped transport local youth to events, such as driving Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke to the Sunday-school picnic and the Debating Club concert. Infatuated with Nell Harcourt, he harbored a deep admiration for her, though his shyness prevented him from speaking to her directly. After his father bestowed the family's upper farm upon him, Barney persuaded his sister Odette to propose marriage to Nell on his behalf. When Nell firmly rejected the proposal, Barney quickly recovered and turned his attentions toward Nettie Scobie. Several years later, he married Nettie Scobie in a prominent wedding and settled down on his upper farm in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c14 P65](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0065), [v1 c19 P36](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0036), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c23 P20](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0020), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v3 c1 P4](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0004), [v4 c8 P0](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0000), [v4 c8 P20](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0020)_
